Class H3MapViewportAndRenderHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.mapcanvas.H3MapViewportAndRenderHelper
public class H3MapViewportAndRenderHelper extends Object
Viewport camera animation controller, spatial index builder, and multi-pass rendering pipeline orchestrator for H3MapCanvas.

Extracted in accordance with the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) to decouple smooth sinusoidal camera flight trajectories, 60-Hz spherical auto-rotation timers, spatial cell indexing, and layered canvas compositing from the JavaFX Canvas state container.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • flyTo

      public void flyTo(H3MapCanvas canvas, H3Globe3DSubScene globe3DSubScene, double targetLat, double targetLng, double targetZoom, Runnable onMiniMapNotify)
      Executes a 1-second smooth cosine-eased camera flight (\( t = \frac{1 - \cos(\pi \tau)}{2} \)) along the shortest longitudinal arc toward the target coordinates and zoom factor.
      Parameters:
      canvas - the host H3MapCanvas
      globe3DSubScene - optional hardware 3D sub-scene to synchronize
      targetLat - target geodetic latitude in degrees \( [-90, 90] \)
      targetLng - target geodetic longitude in degrees \( [-180, 180] \)
      targetZoom - target viewport zoom factor
      onMiniMapNotify - callback notifying the overview MiniMap

    • renderLayers

      public void renderLayers(H3MapCanvas canvas, H3CellColorResolver colorResolver, H3Flat2DRenderer flat2DRenderer, H3Globe3DRenderer globe3DRenderer, H3VectorLayerRenderer vectorLayerRenderer, H3BeaconOverlayRenderer beaconRenderer, H3MapInteractionHandler interactionHandler, Map<Long,Integer> h3ToBufferIndexMap, String currentDateStr)
      Executes the complete multi-layer cartographic rendering pipeline onto the canvas graphics context.
      Parameters:
      canvas - host H3MapCanvas
      colorResolver - cell color and hillshade shader resolver
      flat2DRenderer - 2D equirectangular projection renderer
      globe3DRenderer - 3D orthographic globe renderer
      vectorLayerRenderer - contour, flux vector, resource glyph, and legend renderer
      beaconRenderer - event beacon and corner HUD badge renderer
      interactionHandler - mouse picking and hover tooltip controller
      h3ToBufferIndexMap - mapping from H3 64-bit index to DOD WorldBuffer slot
      currentDateStr - formatted simulation calendar string for HUD display
